label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app
title: EVM Resolve
reasons: Page impersonates a Coinbase Wallet connection flow with a fake connect dialog that mirrors the real Coinbase Wallet SDK UI, including QR code and app selection.
All 'connect' links redirect to a hidden '/connect/index.html' path, indicating a separate drainer page that likely prompts for seed phrases or malicious approvals.
Page disables right-click and developer tools inspection, a tactic used to prevent users from investigating the underlying code.

label: defixs-finance.vercel.app
title: Defix-Finance | One-Stop DeFi Solution
reasons: The bundled JavaScript contains a field named 'seedPhrase' alongside copy promising to 'rectify all strange wallet issues' and 'CLAIM AIRDROP'.
The page presents a fake wallet picker listing real brands (Trust Wallet, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet) to appear legitimate while soliciting sensitive wallet credentials.
The page's own marketing copy ('Your trusted DeFi solution for resolving wallet issues quickly and securely') establishes a pretext for harvesting a seed phrase under the guise of offering support.

label: netflix-login.vercel.app

label: user-review-payout-now-verification.vercel.app
title: Payout Verification · Meta
reasons: The page impersonates Meta's 'Payout Verification' and requests Facebook account credentials: a field named 'c_user' (Facebook user ID), a field named 'xs' (Facebook session token), and a password field.
The page sends the harvested credentials to an external endpoint 'submit-form.com/160H1M8l4' via a POST request.
The page also exfiltrates the same credentials to two additional URLs encoded as binary strings, which decode to 'https://backendr.wasmer.app' and 'https://complete-your-process-now.site/dynamic'.

label: cassie7826.github.io/michael
